inputs.description: The story-level refactor-verify-assess marker; its flagged_tests is the UNION across the story's ACs the Navigator confirmed superseded. (The Navigator writes superseded-tests.json PER AC; the assess finalize aggregates them into this marker, so the story-granularity step reads IT here , a story-root superseded-tests.json never exists for a multi-AC supersession.) The Driver edits ONLY the flagged tests.
